items.name: The-Parity-Shifted-Cyclotomic-Series-and-the-Exceptional-5-Adic-Resonance
items.description: ## What this is  For `k = 4n-2 = 2m` with `m` odd and `ζ = ζ_{2m}`, this package studies the algebraic number  ``` S_{2m} = Σ_{r<m}  ζ^(r²) / (ζ; -ζ)_r²      ∈ ℤ[ζ_{2m}] ```  and asks a purely arithmetic question: **what is the prime factorisation of its norm?**
